name: The Kingdom Of God
overview: The Kingdom of God is a divine and eternal reign established by the God of heaven, destined to supplant all earthly kingdoms and stand forever, as foretold in Daniel 2:44. Jesus inaugurated this kingdom through His call to repentance, emphasizing its nearness and the spiritual blessings for those who are humble and persecuted for righteousness, as seen in Matthew 4:17, 5:3, and 5:10. Believers are encouraged to seek God’s kingdom and righteousness above all else, trusting that God’s will will be done on earth as in heaven (Matthew 6:10, 6:33).
